column1: # The v1 references a v2 file may hold outside the two named homes, src-go/internal/teamchat/v1names
# row per reference, tab separated; # starts a comment line.
#   path      the v2 file, relative to the repository root
#   literal   text on a line of that file which covers the v1 name found there
#   reason    why the reference cannot live in a named home
# A row that covers no finding, or covers findings on more than one line, fails the gate
# teamchat-keeps-off-v1, so this list can neither go stale nor grow unseen.
